name: PvP vendor release stages show each Season 1 phase's vendors only while it is released
contract: rev_20261106_18_coa_pvp_vendor_release_stage puts the phase 1 PvP vendors of rev_20261106_17 in internal
event 197 and the phase 2 vendors of rev_20261008_02/03 in internal event 198. Under the default
Ascension.PvPVendors.ReleaseStage = 1 the worldserver starts only 197 at startup, so Lieutenant Thorne 48051
and Quartermaster Hadwin stand in Champion's Hall and Captain Korgash 49050 and Warbringer Krogash in the Hall
of Legends, while the phase 2 vendors 48053, 48066, 49053 and 49066 are absent. Starting 198, as stage 2 does,
brings the phase 2 vendors to their spawn points and keeps phase 1; stopping both, as stage 0 does, removes
